essence: A boon-giving hand is identified by its wrist resting on the knee.
The lower hand with spread fingers should appear like a blooming lotus.
The hand may be fashioned holding a lotus, blue lotus, serpent, or showing fearlessness.
The figure may be depicted with nose-tip gaze, or with the left hand holding a good book.
The thread on the left should pass in sequence through the heart, navel, and genitals.
